name: com.globalpiggy/onzip
title: ONZIP
description: ONZIP home services: USDC-payable products and x402 payment terms for orders a person opened.

tools.name: onzip_list_usdc_products
tools.description: Lists ONZIP products an agent may pay for in USDC on Base via x402 v2. Prices are set in CAD (tax extra by the home's province). An order must first be opened by the signed-in landlord on the ONZIP web account page; the agent then pays that order's URL.

tools.name: onzip_get_payment_requirements
tools.description: Returns the x402 v2 payment requirements (amount in USDC atomic units, payTo, network, expiry) for an ONZIP order the landlord opened, or its receipt if already paid. Does not move funds.

order_id.description: Order id the landlord gave you: 32 lowercase hex characters.
